final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages), above_average AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT telescref, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS amount_above_overall, avg_modindex / AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS ratio_to_above_average_mean FROM above_average ORDER BY ratio_to_above_average_mean DESC LIMIT 10
